_classes.name: approver_only_actor
_classes.rule: actor_raw head noun (first token after dropping the/of/city/new/york/state) occurs in quote only inside a '(consent|approval|approve|advice and consent) of ...' span (classes.py approver()) [queued for re-ask (brief s8)]

_classes.name: relocated_quote_off_provision
_classes.rule: quote_relocated true and the operative verb after may/shall/must/is authorized to in quote_original is absent from quote (classes.py reloc_off())

_classes.name: act_level_sunset_missing_expires_date
_classes.rule: effective_dates raw_clause matches 'This act shall take effect [^;]*? and shall expire and be deemed repealed <date>.' with no 'provided' before 'expire', and expires_date null (laws, not records); 24 laws with the same pattern do carry expires_date

_classes.name: one_time_study_deadline_none
_classes.rule: kind duty, deliverable_type in (study or audit, plan or strategy, report), recurrence one-time, deadline_kind none, quote lacks if/upon/when/whenever/after/request (over-inclusive; matches need a read)

_classes.name: dropped_designation_with_govt_authorization
_classes.rule: dropped rule designation_no_actor and quote matches 'hereby authoriz|is hereby|are hereby|is authorized|authorizes' [queued for re-ask (brief s8)]

_classes.name: sentence_range_widened_not_recorded
_classes.rule: no mechanical rule: amended 'the period of probation shall be a {{term of ... or}} N years' style widenings of a court's sentencing range

_classes.name: passive_local_law_duty_missed
_classes.rule: no mechanical rule: new matter 'shall be fixed by local law' with no named actor
